title: Meral Karan · 2021-12-17
description:
She wrote directly to Diana and Diana isn't sure what to do. I don't really want her to write back because we're trying to
break the cycle of direct NSC emails to staff.

relationships.title: Staff Chat Log
relationships.evidence:
[opaque block] Google Vault -
No subject
[contact omitted] Meral Karan Friday, December 17, 2021 at 10:12:06 AM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
Hi there - would you be willing to write Mary Beth and just let her know we won't be able to do a presentation on our
information work this week?
[contact omitted] Meral Karan Friday, December 17, 2021 at 10:12:50 AM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
She wrote directly to Diana and Diana isn't sure what to do. I don't really want her to write back because we're trying to
break the cycle of direct NSC emails to staff.
[contact omitted] Meral Karan Friday, December 17, 2021 at 10:13:06 AM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
She and Josh are a little worn out by it, I think
[contact omitted] Meral Karan Friday, December 17, 2021 at 10:13:21 AM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
Instead perhaps propose a brief in January.
[contact omitted] Meral Karan Friday, December 17, 2021 at 10:14:12 AM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
FYI, I'm about to email you a broader email on this subject as SP apparently will go to SOCOM in Feb/March and wants a
memo on our mis/dis/mal info work. So we are working on that too - but might be good to give SP a briefing on it too?
[contact omitted] Meral Karan Friday, December 17, 2021 at 10:14:27 AM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
Anyway, any help you could give with Mary Beth would be greatly appreciated!
[contact omitted] Johnny Walsh Friday, December 17, 2021 at 10:23:05 AM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Meral Karan
hey, sorry i didn't write her back last night! will do so now
[contact omitted] Johnny Walsh Friday, December 17, 2021 at 10:23:13 AM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Meral Karan
let's definitely talk re: SP/tampa/briefing
[contact omitted] Johnny Walsh Friday, December 17, 2021 at 10:24:40 AM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Meral Karan
and on direct contact with NSC directors. in general i try hard NOT to monopolize contact with the nsc - staff should be
able to communicate directly when it's helpful, rather than being caught in a bureaucratic morass. i realize that with some
Directors (ahem) that can be more negative than positive though, so maybe we can look at other arrangements.
[contact omitted] Meral Karan Friday, December 17, 2021 at 10:33:03 AM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
Thanks! Its a tricky balance. In the Missions, you often had the Ambassador directly writing staff for stuff. It can be helpful
but it can cause real headaches. We need a filtration system that doesn't block fully in either direction I guess.
